description: Input contract for the student fail-risk prediction (UCI Student Performance, Portuguese file). Each record is one student.

id_field.name: row_id
id_field.rule: required, non-empty, unique within one request

features.name: failures
features.meaning: Number of past class failures (0-3; 4 means 3 or more)

missing_value_policy: reject: a record with a missing, null or non-integer feature is an error; no imputation
unknown_field_policy: reject: any field other than row_id and the listed features is an error (this blocks G2, G3 and other unverified fields)

output.row_id: same value as the input record
output.score: finite number between 0 and 1 (estimated risk of G3 < 10)
output.version: model version string; 'toy-0' means toy output, not a model

invalid.reason: G1 is a string, not an integer
